build_dataset_builder: build a TensorFlow DatasetBuilder class that downloads and parses XML sentence pairs for semantic similarity and textual entailment
create_dataset_info: create dataset metadata with text, hypothesis, id, entailment labels, and similarity scores for the ASSIN 2 dataset
generate_examples: generate examples by parsing XML sentence pairs and yielding text, hypothesis, id, entailment, and similarity fields
split_generators: split dataset into train, validation, and test splits by downloading and extracting XML files from Google Drive
review_builder_class: review the Builder class that extends GeneratorBasedBuilder for the ASSIN 2 semantic similarity dataset
